how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.

foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: The new check that makes the session read this page on time works, but every step now waits about a second, about 20 minutes a day. A faster version (about a tenth of a second) is ready and needs one line changed in the project's settings, which the permission check refused to let the session do alone. May the session try that one line again on your yes?
sections.recommendation: Yes. If it is refused again, you get the exact line to change by hand. No web link: the answer is this page.
options: Yes, try the one line again (recommended)
